newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-RAIN WASHES OUT STOCKPORT-MIDDLESBROUGH CUP TIE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RAIN WASHES OUT STOCKPORT-MIDDLESBROUGH CUP TIE.

text.p: An English League Cup semifinal first leg tie between second division Stockport and premier league Middlesbrough was postponed on Wednesday because of a waterlogged pitch.
Referee David Elleray called the game off two hours before kick-off after a heavy downpour in Stockport, near Manchester, in northwest England.
No new date has been set for the match.
